question: What technique uses ultrasonic waves to form images of the heart?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Echocardiography**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Echocardiography** is a diagnostic medical procedure that uses **ultrasonic waves** (high-frequency sound waves) to produce live images of the **heart**.
 
• The technique relies on a device called a **transducer**, which emits **ultrasound waves** that bounce off the structures of the heart and return as echoes. These echoes are processed by a computer to create **two-dimensional (2D)** or **three-dimensional (3D)** images.
 
• It is primarily used to evaluate the **pumping function** of the heart, the condition of the **heart valves**, and the size of the **heart chambers**.
